nina (Product Design): quick review request 1: bulk invite/remove modal v3 in Figma: https://go.fig/nina/bulk-v3. main questions: inline field errors vs top summary, required markers in compact table, and confirmation patterns for destructive actions. pinging everyone for quick takes. tom (Design): my reading 1: for row-level validation (e.g., bad email) inline errors are better 1: they directly point to the problem and are faster to fix. keep a small sticky summary at the top for counts only ("3 rows need attention"). rob (PM): agree with inline for editability, but for the required indicator on compressed tables: legal asked for explicit "Required" copy on certain org forms. can we do subtle asterisk + hover text for most, explicit label for compliance fields? kai (Eng): dev constraints: inline errors are great but can cause layout shift if rows expand. prefer using fixed-height rows with an overflow area for error text to avoid jumping. also anchor links from top summary -> row id for keyboard users. anya (A11y): accessibility nits: 1) required markers: asterisk alone is insufficient, include sr-only text "required" or visible "Required" for legal fields. 2) error summary should be role="alert" and focusable so keyboard users land on it. 3) ensure error colors meet 4.5:1 contrast and do not rely on color alone. tom (Design): good call. propose compressed view for teams list: show asterisk + tooltip that says "Required field"; show full "Required" label on expanded forms. For the bulk confirm flow: two patterns: - Soft: single confirm modal + undo toast (30s by default) - Hard: two-step with typed confirm ("REMOVE" exact) for >25 rows or if org policy requires Which one to default to? rob (PM): ops feedback: accidental removals are costly. prefer hard path for large deletions. but we should avoid forcing typed confirm for small ops. make threshold configurable at org level. kai (Eng): implementation notes: when using typed confirm: disable primary action until match; debounce paste events, and validate server-side before commit. for inline error fixes: when user corrects a row, update top summary count in real time. avoid scrolling the list when highlighting error rows. anya (A11y): ARIA snippet suggestion (use in modal): ```html
3 items need attention
Case-sensitive. Paste is allowed but requires exact match.
``` Also: when stepping between modal pages, announce "Step 2 of 2: Confirm removal" via aria-live. ops-bot: telemetry suggestion: emit events: bulk_action_open, bulk_row_error_shown, bulk_row_error_fixed, bulk_confirm_attempt, bulk_confirm_success, bulk_confirm_cancel, bulk_undo_used. include metadata: org_id, user_role, device_type, affected_count. kai (Eng): mobile note: avoid auto-focus on confirm input on iOS because the keyboard can obscure important context. if autofocus is needed, ensure modal scrolls so CTA is visible. also trap focus in modal and provide clear cancel action. rob (PM): decision proposal: A/B test for 6 weeks: Variant A = inline errors + undo toast (30s). Variant B = stepper with typed confirm for >25 rows + undo (5m). Make threshold configurable and surface compliance toggle in admin. Track accidental_removal_rate and time_to_complete. tom (Design): i'll update mocks for both variants and add states: all-good, some-errors, confirm-step, success with undo. microcopy drafts: - Impact summary: "This will remove access for N members. This cannot be undone after the undo period." - Typed confirm prompt: "To confirm, type REMOVE in the box below." nina (Product Design): next steps: tom to push updated Figma screens, kai to estimate engineering effort (include mobile testing), anya to run quick a11y checklist, ops-bot to create telemetry ticket. i'll schedule a 30min follow-up next Tue. thanks all :handshake:
